chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Aʿyan, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Allah, the Exalted, sent down help upon al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام until it filled what was between the heaven and the earth. Then he was given the choice of help or meeting Allah, so he chose meeting Allah, the Exalted.

key_terms.السَّمَاءِ: the heaven, indicating the vastness of the descended help
key_terms.النَّصْرَ: divine help and victory granted by Allah
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth, paired with heaven to express total span
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, the grandson of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.خُيِّرَ: was given a choice between two divinely presented outcomes
key_terms.لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ: meeting Allah, meaning returning to Allah through death in a state of nearness

ai.seo_question: Did Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام choose martyrdom over divine victory?
ai.summary: This hadith states that divine help was made available to al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام in an immense and manifest way. It further indicates that he عليه السلام knowingly chose لقاء الله over worldly victory, reflecting the special station and divinely guided choice of the Imam.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Abdul Malik Bin Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted Sent down the Help upon Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> until it was (suspended in) what is between the sky and the earth. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Gave him<sup>asws</sup> the choice, the Help or Meeting Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> chose meeting Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf ibn ‘Umayra from ‘Abd al-Malik ibn A‘yan from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following. “

Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, sent support for Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) up to the fill between the heavens and earth. Then he was let to choose either victory or meeting Allah. He, however, chose the meeting of Allah the Most High.”
